# Duplex Apartment (external BIM model)

`Duplex_A_20110907.ifc` is the architectural model of a two-storey duplex apartment, exported from
Autodesk Revit Architecture 2011 (IFC2X3, Coordination View). It was not prepared for Mowaem: it is
used to show that the reader opens an independent, real BIM export and reports honestly what it can
and cannot verify.

Source: BSI (2020) "Duplex Apartment Test Files," buildingSMART International.
https://github.com/buildingsmart-community/Community-Sample-Test-Files/tree/main/IFC%202.3.0.1%20(IFC%202x3)/Duplex%20Apartment

unchanged.
